item.title: Musk Backs Cloudflare AI Boom Forecast as Crypto Rails Monetize Bot Surge
item.summary: Elon Musk endorsed Cloudflare's projection that AI agent traffic will dwarf human internet use, potentially by 1,000 times within five years, reviving the question of who pays for it all. Musk didn't mention crypto, but Cloudflare's answer is already taking shape as stablecoin micropayments over the open x402 protocol.
